+    if not crop_root.is_absolute():
+        raise RuntimeError("crop_root_not_canonical_absolute_global_stop")
+    try:
+        root = crop_root.resolve(strict=True)
+        if not root.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("crop_root_not_directory_global_stop")
+        candidate = (root / crop_relative_path(region)).resolve(strict=True)
+        candidate.relative_to(root)
+        if not candidate.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("crop_path_not_file_global_stop")
+    except (FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise RuntimeError("crop_path_invalid_global_stop") from error
+    return candidate
+

+def relocated_regions(
+    regions: Any, crop_root: Path, *, question_id: str
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(regions, list) or not regions:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"question_regions_missing_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    relocated = []
+    for region in regions:
+        if not isinstance(region, dict):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"question_region_type_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        crop = resolve_crop_path(region, crop_root)
+        if not crop.is_file() or sha256_file(crop) != region.get("crop_sha256"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"holdout_crop_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        relocated.append(
+            {
+                **region,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop),
+                "crop_relative_path": crop_relative_path(region).as_posix(),
+            }
+        )
+    return relocated

+def validate_complete_paper_membership(
+    manifest: dict[str, Any], authoritative_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
+) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    papers = frozen.index_rows(manifest.get("papers"), "paper_id", "holdout_paper")
+    questions = frozen.index_rows(
+        manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "holdout_question"
+    )
+    expected: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for paper_id, paper in papers.items():
+        count = paper.get("question_count")
+        if type(count) is not int or count <= 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"paper_question_count_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}"
+            )
+        expected[paper_id] = [f"{paper_id}_q{number:02d}" for number in range(1, count + 1)]
+    expected_ids = [question_id for paper_id in papers for question_id in expected[paper_id]]
+    actual_ids = list(questions)
+    if actual_ids != expected_ids:
+        missing = sorted(set(expected_ids) - set(actual_ids))
+        extra = sorted(set(actual_ids) - set(expected_ids))
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "complete_paper_membership_mismatch_global_stop:"
+            f"missing={','.join(missing)}:extra={','.join(extra)}"
+        )
+    for question_id, row in questions.items():
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)_q(\d{2})", question_id)
+        if match is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"complete_paper_question_id_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+        paper_id, raw_number = match.groups()
+        number = int(raw_number)
+        if row.get("paper_id") != paper_id or row.get("question_number") != number:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"complete_paper_identity_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+    if authoritative_rows is not None:
+        authoritative_ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in authoritative_rows]
+        if actual_ids != authoritative_ids:
+            missing = sorted(set(authoritative_ids) - set(actual_ids))
+            extra = sorted(set(actual_ids) - set(authoritative_ids))
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "authoritative_complete_paper_membership_mismatch_global_stop:"
+                f"missing={','.join(missing)}:extra={','.join(extra)}"
+            )

+def normalize_base_url(value: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_missing_global_stop")
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(value.strip())
+    if (
+        parsed.scheme != "https"
+        or not parsed.hostname
+        or parsed.username is not None
+        or parsed.password is not None
+        or parsed.query
+        or parsed.fragment
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_invalid_global_stop")
+    host = parsed.hostname.lower()
+    port = f":{parsed.port}" if parsed.port is not None else ""
+    path = "/" + "/".join(part for part in parsed.path.split("/") if part)
+    if path == "/":
+        path = ""
+    return f"https://{host}{port}{path}"
+

+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "request_timeout_mismatch_global_stop:"
+            f"observed={timeout}:expected={REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}"
+        )
+    return {

+        "request_timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        "model": frozen.base.DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        "concurrency": 1,
+        "provider_posture": "local_ai2_pc_only",
+    }

+def validate_bound_provenance(value: dict[str, Any], contract: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    keys = (
+        "provider_base_url_normalized",
+        "request_timeout_seconds",
+        "model",
+        "concurrency",
+        "provider_posture",
+    )
+    mismatched = [key for key in keys if value.get(key) != contract.get(key)]
+    if mismatched:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "execution_provenance_mismatch_global_stop:keys=" + ",".join(mismatched)
+        )

+def build_provenance_surfaces(
+    contract: dict[str, Any], row: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    request_hashes = {
+        pass_name: [
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(attempt.get("request")))
+            for attempt in row.get(f"{pass_name}_pass", {}).get("attempts", [])
+        ]
+        for pass_name in ("full", "mark")
+    }
+    surfaces = {
+        "preflight": dict(contract),
+        "request": {**contract, "source_request_sha256": request_hashes},
+        "terminal": dict(contract),
+        "resume": dict(contract),
+    }
+    for value in surfaces.values():
+        validate_bound_provenance(value, contract)
+    return surfaces

+    historical_hashes = verify_historical_artifacts()

+def validate_replayed_evaluation(
+    *,
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any],
+    full_candidate: Any,
+    full_error: str | None,
+    mark_error: str | None,
+    question_id: str,
+) -> tuple[str, list[str], bool]:
+    """Compare evaluation fields before comparing terminal-derived warnings."""
+    evaluation_keys = [key for key in frozen.EVALUATED_KEYS if key != "warnings"]
+    evaluation_mismatches = [
+        key for key in evaluation_keys if row.get(key) != evaluated.get(key)
+    ]
+    if evaluation_mismatches:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_evaluation_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}:"
+            f"keys={','.join(evaluation_mismatches)}"
+        )
+    status, final_warnings = frozen.terminal_status(
+        evaluated, full_candidate, full_error, mark_error
+    )
+    if row.get("terminal_status") != status:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_status_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+        )
+    if row.get("warnings") != final_warnings:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_warning_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+        )

+def replay_rows(
+    *,
+    manifest: dict[str, Any],
+    truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    source_run_root: Path,
+    selection: str,
+    contract: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    checkpoint = source_run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl"
+    if sha256_file(checkpoint) != SOURCE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    completed = frozen.index_rows(
+        batch.load_checkpoint(checkpoint), "question_id", "source_checkpoint"
+    )
+    sources = frozen.index_rows(
+        manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "replay_source"
+    )
+    expected_all = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    if set(completed) != set(expected_all):
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest_sha = SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    truth_sha = SOURCE_TRUTH_SHA256
+    selected = _selection_ids(manifest, selection)
+    replayed_rows = []
+    receipts = []
+    for question_id in selected:
+        row = completed[question_id]
+        validate_historical_terminal(row, question_id, manifest_sha, truth_sha)
+        package = source_run_root / "questions" / question_id
+        terminal_path = package / "terminal-row.json"
+        if not terminal_path.is_file() or read_json(terminal_path) != row:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"terminal_file_checkpoint_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+        full_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "full", row.get("full_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        mark_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "mark", row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        if full_candidate != row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"full_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        if mark_candidate != row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"mark_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        evaluated = frozen.evaluate(
+            sources[question_id],
+            full_candidate,
+            mark_candidate,
+            truth[question_id]["expected"],
+        )
+        full_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("full_pass"), "full")
+        mark_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("mark_pass"), "mark")
+        status, final_warnings, warning_order_fix_exercised = validate_replayed_evaluation(
+            row=row,
+            evaluated=evaluated,
+            full_candidate=full_candidate,
+            full_error=full_error,
+            mark_error=mark_error,
+            question_id=question_id,
+        )
+        replayed = {**row, "warnings": final_warnings, "terminal_status": status}
+        replayed_rows.append(replayed)
+        before_category = None if row["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(row)
+        after_category = (
+            None if replayed["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(replayed)
+        )
+        provenance = {
+            "source_terminal_sha256": sha256_file(terminal_path),
+            "source_full_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(full_candidate)),
+            "source_mark_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(mark_candidate)),
+            "surfaces": build_provenance_surfaces(contract, row),
+            "provider_calls_during_replay": 0,
+        }
+        receipts.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "before": {
+                    "terminal_status": row["terminal_status"],
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": row["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": before_category,
+                },
+                "after": {
+                    "terminal_status": status,
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": replayed["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": after_category,
+                },
+                "raw_candidate_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "evaluation_fields_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_status_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "final_warning_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_warning_order_fix_exercised": warning_order_fix_exercised,
+                "provenance": provenance,
+            }
+        )
+    return replayed_rows, receipts

+def _metrics(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    total = len(rows)
+    first = sum(row["first_pass_all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    final = sum(row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    residuals = [row for row in rows if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]]
+    categories = Counter(residual_category(row) for row in residuals)
+    full_attempts = sum(len(row["full_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    mark_attempts = sum(len(row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    return {
+        "question_count": total,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_count": first,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_rate": first / total if total else 0,
+        "final_exact_match_count": final,
+        "final_exact_match_rate": final / total if total else 0,
+        "residual_count": len(residuals),
+        "residual_category_counts": dict(sorted(categories.items())),
+        "source_full_attempt_count": full_attempts,
+        "source_mark_attempt_count": mark_attempts,
+        "source_provider_attempt_count": full_attempts + mark_attempts,
+        "source_retry_count": (full_attempts + mark_attempts) - (2 * total),
+        "replay_provider_call_count": 0,
+        "terminal_provider_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "infrastructure_or_provider_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "schema_protocol_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "schema_protocol_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "normalization_failure_count": categories.get("normalization_failure", 0),
+        "semantic_model_disagreement_count": categories.get(
+            "semantic_model_disagreement", 0
+        ),
+    }

+def crop_relative_path(region: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
+    relative = region.get("crop_relative_path")
+    if isinstance(relative, str) and relative:
+        candidate = Path(relative)
+    else:
+        external = region.get("crop_external_path")
+        if not isinstance(external, str) or not external:

+        except ValueError as error:
+            raise RuntimeError("crop_reference_not_relocatable_global_stop") from error
+        candidate = Path(*parts[marker:])

+def resolve_crop_path(region: dict[str, Any], crop_root: Path) -> Path:
+    if not crop_root.is_absolute():
+        raise RuntimeError("crop_root_not_canonical_absolute_global_stop")
+    try:
+        root = crop_root.resolve(strict=True)
+        if not root.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("crop_root_not_directory_global_stop")
+        candidate = (root / crop_relative_path(region)).resolve(strict=True)
+        candidate.relative_to(root)
+        if not candidate.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("crop_path_not_file_global_stop")
+    except (FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise RuntimeError("crop_path_invalid_global_stop") from error
+    return candidate

+def normalize_base_url(value: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_missing_global_stop")
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(value.strip())
+    if (
+        parsed.scheme != "https"
+        or not parsed.hostname
+        or parsed.username is not None
+        or parsed.password is not None
+        or parsed.query
+        or parsed.fragment
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_invalid_global_stop")
+    host = parsed.hostname.lower()
+    port = f":{parsed.port}" if parsed.port is not None else ""
+    path = "/" + "/".join(part for part in parsed.path.split("/") if part)
+    if path == "/":
+        path = ""
+    return f"https://{host}{port}{path}"

+def build_provenance_surfaces(
+    contract: dict[str, Any], row: dict[str, Any]

+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(attempt.get("request")))

+        "request": {**contract, "source_request_sha256": request_hashes},
+        "terminal": dict(contract),
+        "resume": dict(contract),
+    }
+    for value in surfaces.values():
+        validate_bound_provenance(value, contract)
+    return surfaces

+def replay_rows(
+    *,
+    manifest: dict[str, Any],
+    truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    source_run_root: Path,
+    selection: str,
+    contract: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    checkpoint = source_run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl"
+    if sha256_file(checkpoint) != SOURCE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    completed = frozen.index_rows(
+        batch.load_checkpoint(checkpoint), "question_id", "source_checkpoint"
+    )
+    sources = frozen.index_rows(
+        manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "replay_source"
+    )
+    expected_all = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    if set(completed) != set(expected_all):
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest_sha = SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    truth_sha = SOURCE_TRUTH_SHA256
+    selected = _selection_ids(manifest, selection)
+    replayed_rows = []
+    receipts = []
+    for question_id in selected:
+        row = completed[question_id]
+        validate_historical_terminal(row, question_id, manifest_sha, truth_sha)
+        package = source_run_root / "questions" / question_id
+        terminal_path = package / "terminal-row.json"
+        if not terminal_path.is_file() or read_json(terminal_path) != row:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"terminal_file_checkpoint_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+        full_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "full", row.get("full_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        mark_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "mark", row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        if full_candidate != row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"full_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")

+            raise RuntimeError(f"mark_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        evaluated = frozen.evaluate(
+            sources[question_id],
+            full_candidate,
+            mark_candidate,
+            truth[question_id]["expected"],
+        )
+        full_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("full_pass"), "full")
+        mark_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("mark_pass"), "mark")

+            row=row,

+            full_error=full_error,
+            mark_error=mark_error,
+            question_id=question_id,

+        replayed_rows.append(replayed)
+        before_category = None if row["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(row)
+        after_category = (
+            None if replayed["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(replayed)
+        )
+        provenance = {
+            "source_terminal_sha256": sha256_file(terminal_path),
+            "source_full_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(full_candidate)),
+            "source_mark_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(mark_candidate)),
+            "surfaces": build_provenance_surfaces(contract, row),
+            "provider_calls_during_replay": 0,
+        }
+        receipts.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "before": {
+                    "terminal_status": row["terminal_status"],
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": row["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": before_category,
+                },
+                "after": {
+                    "terminal_status": status,
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": replayed["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": after_category,
+                },
+                "raw_candidate_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "evaluation_fields_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_status_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "final_warning_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_warning_order_fix_exercised": warning_order_fix_exercised,
+                "provenance": provenance,
+            }
+        )

+def _metrics(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    total = len(rows)
+    first = sum(row["first_pass_all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    final = sum(row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    residuals = [row for row in rows if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]]
+    categories = Counter(residual_category(row) for row in residuals)
+    full_attempts = sum(len(row["full_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    mark_attempts = sum(len(row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    return {
+        "question_count": total,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_count": first,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_rate": first / total if total else 0,
+        "final_exact_match_count": final,
+        "final_exact_match_rate": final / total if total else 0,
+        "residual_count": len(residuals),
+        "residual_category_counts": dict(sorted(categories.items())),
+        "source_full_attempt_count": full_attempts,
+        "source_mark_attempt_count": mark_attempts,
+        "source_provider_attempt_count": full_attempts + mark_attempts,
+        "source_retry_count": (full_attempts + mark_attempts) - (2 * total),
+        "replay_provider_call_count": 0,
+        "terminal_provider_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "infrastructure_or_provider_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "schema_protocol_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "schema_protocol_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "normalization_failure_count": categories.get("normalization_failure", 0),
+        "semantic_model_disagreement_count": categories.get(
+            "semantic_model_disagreement", 0
+        ),
+    }

+        missing = sorted(set(expected_ids) - set(actual_ids))
+        extra = sorted(set(actual_ids) - set(expected_ids))
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "complete_paper_membership_mismatch_global_stop:"
+            f"missing={','.join(missing)}:extra={','.join(extra)}"
+        )
+    for question_id, row in questions.items():
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)_q(\d{2})", question_id)
+        if match is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"complete_paper_question_id_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+        paper_id, raw_number = match.groups()
+        number = int(raw_number)
+        if row.get("paper_id") != paper_id or row.get("question_number") != number:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"complete_paper_identity_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+    if authoritative_rows is not None:
+        authoritative_ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in authoritative_rows]
+        if actual_ids != authoritative_ids:
+            missing = sorted(set(authoritative_ids) - set(actual_ids))
+            extra = sorted(set(actual_ids) - set(authoritative_ids))
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "authoritative_complete_paper_membership_mismatch_global_stop:"
+                f"missing={','.join(missing)}:extra={','.join(extra)}"
+            )
+    return expected
+
+
+def normalize_base_url(value: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_missing_global_stop")
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(value.strip())
+    if (
+        parsed.scheme != "https"
+        or not parsed.hostname
+        or parsed.username is not None
+        or parsed.password is not None
+        or parsed.query
+        or parsed.fragment
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("provider_base_url_invalid_global_stop")
+    host = parsed.hostname.lower()
+    port = f":{parsed.port}" if parsed.port is not None else ""
+    path = "/" + "/".join(part for part in parsed.path.split("/") if part)
+    if path == "/":
+        path = ""
+    return f"https://{host}{port}{path}"
+
+
+def execution_contract(base_url: str, timeout: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if timeout != REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "request_timeout_mismatch_global_stop:"
+            f"observed={timeout}:expected={REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}"
+        )
+    return {
+        "provider_base_url_normalized": normalize_base_url(base_url),
+        "request_timeout_seconds": REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        "model": frozen.base.DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        "concurrency": 1,
+        "provider_posture": "local_ai2_pc_only",
+    }
+
+
+def validate_bound_provenance(value: dict[str, Any], contract: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    keys = (
+        "provider_base_url_normalized",
+        "request_timeout_seconds",
+        "model",
+        "concurrency",
+        "provider_posture",
+    )
+    mismatched = [key for key in keys if value.get(key) != contract.get(key)]
+    if mismatched:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "execution_provenance_mismatch_global_stop:keys=" + ",".join(mismatched)
+        )
+
+
+def build_provenance_surfaces(
+    contract: dict[str, Any], row: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    request_hashes = {
+        pass_name: [
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(attempt.get("request")))
+            for attempt in row.get(f"{pass_name}_pass", {}).get("attempts", [])
+        ]
+        for pass_name in ("full", "mark")
+    }
+    surfaces = {
+        "preflight": dict(contract),
+        "request": {**contract, "source_request_sha256": request_hashes},
+        "terminal": dict(contract),
+        "resume": dict(contract),
+    }
+    for value in surfaces.values():
+        validate_bound_provenance(value, contract)
+    return surfaces
+
+
+def validate_inputs(
+    manifest_path: Path, truth_path: Path, crop_root: Path
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    base_receipt = verify_base_relationship()
+    historical_hashes = verify_historical_artifacts()
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_manifest_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    if sha256_file(truth_path) != SOURCE_TRUTH_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_truth_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    truth_document = read_json(truth_path)
+    if manifest.get("base", {}).get("required_sha") != SOURCE_BASE_SHA:
+        raise RuntimeError("manifest_source_base_binding_invalid_global_stop")
+    if (
+        manifest.get("runner", {}).get("execution_harness_sha256")
+        != SOURCE_RUNNER_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("manifest_source_runner_binding_invalid_global_stop")
+    recomputed_papers, recomputed_rows, _ = historical.population()
+    if [paper["paper_id"] for paper in manifest.get("papers", [])] != [
+        paper["paper_id"] for paper in recomputed_papers
+    ]:
+        raise RuntimeError("authoritative_complete_paper_set_mismatch_global_stop")
+    validate_complete_paper_membership(manifest, recomputed_rows)
+    questions = frozen.index_rows(
+        manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "holdout_question"
+    )
+    truth = frozen.index_rows(truth_document.get("rows"), "question_id", "holdout_truth")
+    if set(questions) != set(truth) or len(questions) != 249:
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_truth_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    if truth_document.get("candidate_responses_used_for_truth_derivation") is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_truth_not_candidate_blind_global_stop")
+    for paper in manifest["papers"]:
+        source = (REPO / paper["source_path"]).resolve()
+        if (
+            not source.is_file()
+            or sha256_file(source) != paper.get("pdf_sha256")
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"official_pdf_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{paper['paper_id']}"
+            )
+    region_count = 0
+    crop_membership = []
+    for question_id, question in questions.items():
+        validate_expected(
+            truth[question_id].get("expected"),
+            question.get("question_number"),
+            question_id,
+        )
+        regions = relocated_regions(
+            question.get("regions"), crop_root, question_id=question_id
+        )
+        region_count += len(regions)
+        crop_membership.extend(
+            {
+                "path": region["crop_relative_path"],
+                "sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        )
+        pages = [region.get("page_number") for region in regions]
+        if pages != question.get("complete_page_chain"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"holdout_page_chain_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        full_image, mark_image = frozen.build_question_images(regions)
+        expected = question.get("pre_call_rendered_image_sha256", {})
+        if (
+            sha256_bytes(full_image["bytes"]) != expected.get("full_question")
+            or sha256_bytes(mark_image["bytes"]) != expected.get("right_edge_marks")
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"holdout_render_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    return manifest, truth, {
+        "base": base_receipt,
+        "historical_artifact_sha256": historical_hashes,
+        "historical_runner_sha256": SOURCE_RUNNER_SHA256,
+        "question_count": len(questions),
+        "paper_count": len(manifest["papers"]),
+        "region_count": region_count,
+        "crop_root_binding": "operator_supplied_external_root_not_published",
+        "crop_membership_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(crop_membership)),
+        "crop_reference_posture": "relocatable_external_root_with_frozen_relative_paths_and_hashes",
+    }
+
+
+def _historical_terminal_expected(
+    question_id: str, manifest_sha: str, truth_sha: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "issue": SOURCE_ISSUE,
+        "question_id": question_id,
+        "run_id": SOURCE_RUN_ID,
+        "input_manifest_sha256": manifest_sha,
+        "independent_truth_sha256": truth_sha,
+        "execution_harness_sha256": SOURCE_RUNNER_SHA256,
+        "predecessor_runner_sha256": historical.PREDECESSOR_RUNNER_SHA256,
+        "model": frozen.base.DEFAULT_MODEL,
+        "prompt_version": historical.PROMPT_VERSION,
+        "max_retries_per_request": historical.MAX_RETRIES,
+    }
+
+
+def validate_historical_terminal(
+    row: dict[str, Any], question_id: str, manifest_sha: str, truth_sha: str
+) -> None:
+    expected = _historical_terminal_expected(question_id, manifest_sha, truth_sha)
+    mismatched = [key for key, value in expected.items() if row.get(key) != value]
+    if mismatched:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"historical_terminal_provenance_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}:"
+            f"keys={','.join(mismatched)}"
+        )
+
+
+def residual_category(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return historical.residual_category(row)
+
+
+def validate_replayed_evaluation(
+    *,
+    row: dict[str, Any],
+    evaluated: dict[str, Any],
+    full_candidate: Any,
+    full_error: str | None,
+    mark_error: str | None,
+    question_id: str,
+) -> tuple[str, list[str], bool]:
+    """Compare evaluation fields before comparing terminal-derived warnings."""
+    evaluation_keys = [key for key in frozen.EVALUATED_KEYS if key != "warnings"]
+    evaluation_mismatches = [
+        key for key in evaluation_keys if row.get(key) != evaluated.get(key)
+    ]
+    if evaluation_mismatches:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_evaluation_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}:"
+            f"keys={','.join(evaluation_mismatches)}"
+        )
+    status, final_warnings = frozen.terminal_status(
+        evaluated, full_candidate, full_error, mark_error
+    )
+    if row.get("terminal_status") != status:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_status_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+        )
+    if row.get("warnings") != final_warnings:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"terminal_warning_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+        )
+    return status, final_warnings, evaluated.get("warnings") != final_warnings
+
+
+def _selection_ids(manifest: dict[str, Any], selection: str) -> list[str]:
+    all_ids = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    if selection == "targeted":
+        if any(question_id not in all_ids for question_id in TARGET_IDS):
+            raise RuntimeError("target_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+        return list(TARGET_IDS)
+    if selection == "full":
+        return all_ids
+    raise RuntimeError(f"selection_invalid_global_stop:{selection}")
+
+
+def replay_rows(
+    *,
+    manifest: dict[str, Any],
+    truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    source_run_root: Path,
+    selection: str,
+    contract: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    checkpoint = source_run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl"
+    if sha256_file(checkpoint) != SOURCE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    completed = frozen.index_rows(
+        batch.load_checkpoint(checkpoint), "question_id", "source_checkpoint"
+    )
+    sources = frozen.index_rows(
+        manifest.get("questions"), "question_id", "replay_source"
+    )
+    expected_all = [row["question_id"] for row in manifest["questions"]]
+    if set(completed) != set(expected_all):
+        raise RuntimeError("source_checkpoint_membership_mismatch_global_stop")
+    manifest_sha = SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    truth_sha = SOURCE_TRUTH_SHA256
+    selected = _selection_ids(manifest, selection)
+    replayed_rows = []
+    receipts = []
+    for question_id in selected:
+        row = completed[question_id]
+        validate_historical_terminal(row, question_id, manifest_sha, truth_sha)
+        package = source_run_root / "questions" / question_id
+        terminal_path = package / "terminal-row.json"
+        if not terminal_path.is_file() or read_json(terminal_path) != row:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"terminal_file_checkpoint_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}"
+            )
+        full_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "full", row.get("full_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        mark_candidate = frozen._verify_attempts(
+            package, "mark", row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("attempts")
+        )
+        if full_candidate != row.get("full_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"full_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        if mark_candidate != row.get("mark_pass", {}).get("raw_candidate"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"mark_candidate_replay_mismatch_global_stop:{question_id}")
+        evaluated = frozen.evaluate(
+            sources[question_id],
+            full_candidate,
+            mark_candidate,
+            truth[question_id]["expected"],
+        )
+        full_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("full_pass"), "full")
+        mark_error = frozen._stored_pass_error(row.get("mark_pass"), "mark")
+        status, final_warnings, warning_order_fix_exercised = validate_replayed_evaluation(
+            row=row,
+            evaluated=evaluated,
+            full_candidate=full_candidate,
+            full_error=full_error,
+            mark_error=mark_error,
+            question_id=question_id,
+        )
+        replayed = {**row, "warnings": final_warnings, "terminal_status": status}
+        replayed_rows.append(replayed)
+        before_category = None if row["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(row)
+        after_category = (
+            None if replayed["all_field_checks_pass"] else residual_category(replayed)
+        )
+        provenance = {
+            "source_terminal_sha256": sha256_file(terminal_path),
+            "source_full_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(full_candidate)),
+            "source_mark_candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(mark_candidate)),
+            "surfaces": build_provenance_surfaces(contract, row),
+            "provider_calls_during_replay": 0,
+        }
+        receipts.append(
+            {
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "before": {
+                    "terminal_status": row["terminal_status"],
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": row["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": before_category,
+                },
+                "after": {
+                    "terminal_status": status,
+                    "all_field_checks_pass": replayed["all_field_checks_pass"],
+                    "classification": after_category,
+                },
+                "raw_candidate_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "evaluation_fields_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_status_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "final_warning_reconstruction_match": True,
+                "terminal_warning_order_fix_exercised": warning_order_fix_exercised,
+                "provenance": provenance,
+            }
+        )
+    return replayed_rows, receipts
+
+
+def _metrics(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    total = len(rows)
+    first = sum(row["first_pass_all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    final = sum(row["all_field_checks_pass"] for row in rows)
+    residuals = [row for row in rows if not row["all_field_checks_pass"]]
+    categories = Counter(residual_category(row) for row in residuals)
+    full_attempts = sum(len(row["full_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    mark_attempts = sum(len(row["mark_pass"]["attempts"]) for row in rows)
+    return {
+        "question_count": total,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_count": first,
+        "first_pass_exact_match_rate": first / total if total else 0,
+        "final_exact_match_count": final,
+        "final_exact_match_rate": final / total if total else 0,
+        "residual_count": len(residuals),
+        "residual_category_counts": dict(sorted(categories.items())),
+        "source_full_attempt_count": full_attempts,
+        "source_mark_attempt_count": mark_attempts,
+        "source_provider_attempt_count": full_attempts + mark_attempts,
+        "source_retry_count": (full_attempts + mark_attempts) - (2 * total),
+        "replay_provider_call_count": 0,
+        "terminal_provider_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "infrastructure_or_provider_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "schema_protocol_failure_count": categories.get(
+            "schema_protocol_failure", 0
+        ),
+        "normalization_failure_count": categories.get("normalization_failure", 0),
+        "semantic_model_disagreement_count": categories.get(
+            "semantic_model_disagreement", 0
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _compact_reconstruction(
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    manifest: dict[str, Any],
+    truth: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    source_run_root: Path,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    documents = historical.finalize(
+        rows,
+        manifest,
+        truth,
+        DEFAULT_TRUTH,
+        source_run_root / "checkpoint.jsonl",
+    )
+    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for name, document in zip(historical.COMPACT_NAMES, documents):
+        reconstructed = canonical_bytes(document)
+        source_path = source_run_root / name
+        checked_in_path = SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ROOT / name
+        if (
+            source_path.read_bytes() != reconstructed
+            or checked_in_path.read_bytes() != reconstructed
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"compact_artifact_reconstruction_mismatch_global_stop:{name}")
+        hashes[name] = sha256_bytes(reconstructed)
+    return {
+        "compact_artifact_sha256": hashes,
+        "source_run_copy_byte_identical": True,
+        "checked_in_copy_byte_identical": True,
+    }
+
+
+def _artifact_name(selection: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        "targeted-replay-receipt.v1.json"
+        if selection == "targeted"
+        else "full-regression-results.v1.json"
+    )
+
+
+def replay(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    contract = execution_contract(args.base_url, args.timeout)
+    manifest, truth, integrity = validate_inputs(
+        args.manifest.resolve(), args.truth.resolve(), args.crop_root.resolve()
+    )
+    rows, receipts = replay_rows(
+        manifest=manifest,
+        truth=truth,
+        source_run_root=args.source_run_root.resolve(),
+        selection=args.selection,
+        contract=contract,
+    )
+    metrics = _metrics(rows)
+    document = {
+        "schema_version": f"9709_local_vlm_holdout_{args.selection}_repair_replay_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "source_issue": SOURCE_ISSUE,
+        "classification": "repair_regression_not_independent_holdout",
+        "selection": args.selection,
+        "source_run_id": SOURCE_RUN_ID,
+        "source_manifest_sha256": SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "source_truth_sha256": SOURCE_TRUTH_SHA256,
+        "source_checkpoint_sha256": SOURCE_CHECKPOINT_SHA256,
+        "repair_runner_sha256": sha256_file(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+        "execution_contract": contract,
+        "metrics_before": metrics,
+        "metrics_after": metrics,
+        "candidate_behavior_changed": False,
+        "provider_calls_during_replay": 0,
+        "cost": {"currency": "CNY", "amount": 0},
+        "rows": receipts,
+    }
+    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    output_path = args.output_dir / _artifact_name(args.selection)
+    write_once_document(output_path, document, kind="repair_artifact")
